name: Stavrolen-Nevinnomyssk Gas Pipeline (LUKOIL)

values.EndLocation: Gazprom system receiving point near Nevinnomyssk

researcher_notes: No match in GGIT roster (checked Stavrolen/Nevinnomyssk/Budyonnovsk/Stavropol rows: P2343 Mozdok-Nevinnomyssk, P2339 Maykop-Nevinnomyssk, P0793 Stavropol-Moscow are other lines); new line from LUKOIL's Stavrolen gas-chemicals/petrochemical site into the Gazprom GTS, North Caspian gas. Threshold: (a) sponsor LUKOIL (developer LUKOIL-Nizhnevolzhskneft-Kalmykia, designer Gipvostokneft) per Neftegaz.ru 2023-11-08 quoting LUKOIL press service; (b) endpoints + route districts (Budyonnovsk, Novoselitsky, Aleksandrovsky, Mineralovodsky, Andropovsky, Kochubeevsky, Nevinnomyssk) in Stavropol Krai; (c) concrete step = positive Glavgosekspertiza conclusion on design documentation and surveys (8 Nov 2023) plus a booster compressor station near Stavrolen; (d) length 'just over 222 km' sourced, >=25 km, domestic. Second source: Russian Government order 816-r Annex 4 item 341 'Gazoprovod ot OOO Stavrolen do rayona g. Nevinnomyssk' (~4.4 bcm/y, DKS 35 MW, GIS ~4.4 bcm/y, North Caspian gas); independent of the press release (government planning document). Status proposed: design approved, no construction start or FID verified from a fetched source (a search summary says construction from 2026, not cited, unverified). Diameter, cost, pressure not found; none filled. ProposalYear 2023 = earliest dated evidence (Glavgosekspertiza approval), true proposal year may be earlier. Owner/Parent entities: Parent reuses existing 'LUKOIL PJSC' entity (entity_lookup 100); the developer subsidiary has no tracker entity (stage as new; confirm whether it is owner vs LUKOIL parent-level). Route: no official GIS or published trace found; route ladder not run (district list only), RouteType/Accuracy 'no route' pending a route-creation pass. Tier high: two validated independent refs naming the pipeline.
